answer_1.quote: As NLP technologies have been widely adopted to build multilingual news generators, it is important that these differences are taken into account in language generation.

answer_4.quote: Careful documentation of the annotation process also plays an important role. In a recent survey of machine learning papers (including NLP ones), reported a wide divergence in the level of documentation about methodological practices in human annotation.
answer_4.guideline: Annotator disagreements may capture important nuances in such tasks that are often ignored while aggregating annotations to a single (possibly hegemonic) ground truth. Release of all annotations with each dataset, even disagreeing ones, allows training models that generalise better.
